programme.title: Phir Teri Kahani Yaad Aayee
programme.desc: A troubled filmmaker enters rehabilitation to confront his alcoholism. However, things take a turn when he forms a deep connection with his inmate.

programme.title: Salaami
programme.desc: After Vijay, a young army cadet, finds evidence against the corrupt officer, Gautam, he gets entangled in a never-ending battle with the police, which puts his career and his family in trouble.

programme.title: Fillers
programme.desc: A comprehensive compilation of promotional videos and trailers of Bollywood movies featuring popular actors and actresses.

programme.title: Laalchee
programme.desc: To usurp the property from its ailing patriarch, a family hatches a plan and brings home an imposter as the lost grandson. However, the young man has plans of his own.

programme.title: Khatron Ke Khiladi
programme.desc: Balwant, a truck driver, is driven into the underworld as he wants to take revenge on the owners of the trucking company for the death of his brother.

programme.title: Jaan Se Pyaara
programme.desc: Inspector Jai balances working as a cop with taking care of his mother and a brother with developmental disabilities. But when he arrests a local don, he starts to fear for his family's safety.

programme.title: Henna
programme.desc: Henna, a bubbly young woman based in a village in Pakistan, sets her heart on an endearing stranger who winds up there with serious injuries and no memory of his past.

programme.title: Seeta Aur Geeta
programme.desc: Twin sisters who are separated at birth, cause chaos when they swap places.

programme.title: Ghatak
programme.desc: When Kashi visits a community with his father, he is shocked to see the torturous regime of Katya. He tries to oppose Katya, but ends up compromising the safety of his family and relatives.

programme.title: Gangaajal
programme.desc: IPS Amit Kumar, an honest police officer, is tasked with curbing Tezpur's rampant crime rates. Here he must work with his fellow corrupt officers and deal with the town's insidious political figures.

programme.title: Sankat City
programme.desc: Trouble strikes when Guru and Ganpat, two petty thieves, steal a car belonging to Faujdaar, a gangster, along with the hefty amount of money in the car.

programme.title: Roop Ki Rani Choron Ka Raja
programme.desc: Three friends, orphaned by an evil man, set out to take revenge for their father's murders. They are forced to navigate a complex web of deceit and stolen identities before they can reach their goal.

programme.title: Rehnaa Hai Terre Dil Mein
programme.desc: Maddy has seven days to win Reena's affections before she finds out that he is not Rajeev, the childhood friend and prospective fiancé she has been expecting.

programme.title: Mr. & Mrs. Khiladi
programme.desc: When stars misalign, love blossoms between an astrology-obsessed idler and a headstrong fish heiress whose father will settle for nothing less than a hardworking son-in-law.

programme.title: Muqabla
programme.desc: Brothers Suraj and Deepak work for the police as a havildar and a traffic constable respectively. However, they soon turn against each other when Deepak testifies in favour of a criminal.

programme.title: Mr. India
programme.desc: Hoping to make the world a better place for orphaned children, a compassionate street musician takes on a power-hungry crime boss with the help of a cloaking device.

programme.title: Khiladiyon Ka Khiladi
programme.desc: A man comes to America in order to find his brother who is wanted by the police. But his search forces him to get mixed up with a lady gangster that facilitates illegal underground fights.

programme.title: Indian
programme.desc: Police officer Raj Azad arrests terrorist Wasim Khan and prepares to interrogate him. However, his father-in-law mysteriously dies, after which he is blamed for his death and goes on the run.

programme.title: Insan
programme.desc: Ajit Rathod, a grieving policeman, vows to catch his wife's killer, terrorist Azhar Khan. He pursues Azhar with single-minded focus, overcoming all hurdles.
